#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Awww
#bot.Expression.VeryShock
Lady Annalie: Whose idea was it to come here? This fucking sucks!
You: Annalie, please there are people around…
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Open
Lady Annalie: I almost crushed my skull on this freaking ice and you care about people? {{wi}}Fuck’em
She seems not to be in a mood…
#bot.Expression.clear
You: Once you get a little practice it will get better, trust me.
Lady Annalie: Not everyone is rich like you, you know? I still have work after this. Being all tired and sweaty will suck.
You: Again. Please, be mindful of the kids… People are staring.
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Awww
Lady Annalie: It’s almost as if you want to piss me off.
